summary.text: Gallop Franklin II represents District 8 in the Florida House of Representatives as a Democrat, elected in 2022 and reelected subsequently.

paragraphs.text: Franklin lives in Tallahassee, where Franklin was born, and works in healthcare, real estate and education.
Franklin holds a PharmD from Florida A&M University and an M.S. and MBA from Cornell University.
